data.action: 单手抱着宇航头盔立于月球灰白岩原，仰望漆黑星空中巨大的蔚蓝地球
data.camera: sweeping wide landscape, full body, sublime cosmic scale
data.description: 【露西 · 荒凉月表的蔚蓝地出漫步】寂静无声的月球静海灰白平原上，无数环形山延绵至星空尽头。露西身穿轻型白色太空服，头盔夹在臂弯之下。她独立在细密的月壤上，迎着宇宙的永恒微风，仰望着漆黑天幕中那一颗璀璨升起的蔚蓝地球。没有枪声、没有荒坂、没有杀戮，她的眼中倒映着地球的蓝光，嘴角泛起释怀而又悲悯的微笑。

data.promptProse: Lucy stands alone on the Sea of Tranquility's gray regolith in a white-and-silver lunar suit, clear helmet tucked under one arm above moon-dust boots. She watches the blue Earth rise with a relieved smile. The full-body wide landscape carries overlapping craters toward a black starfield. Direct sunlight sharply defines the suit and ground ridges without atmospheric haze, while faint blue Earthlight touches the shaded side of her face.
data.title: 露西 · 荒凉月表的蔚蓝地出漫步
